MATCHDAY 2 READY. ⚔️💙
Coming off an electric opening win, we’re back on the pitch this Saturday night to take on Bay Area United.
Big test ahead and we’re hungry for another 3 points. Come out, pack the sidelines, and bring the energy—we need all of you with us!
📅 Saturday, Sept 19 | 7:30 PM
📍 Fair Oaks Park Field 3, Sunnyvale, CA
See you under the lights. Let’s get it! 🔥
#swpl #soccer #bayareasoccer #calblue

MAN OF THE MATCH: Ray Zhang @zhangrui_29 🌟⚡️
2 goals. 1 assist. Directly involved in every single goal of our 3-2 debut thriller.
From the first whistle to the 90th minute, relentless pressing, off-the-ball running, and constant pressure that forced mistakes and never let their backline breathe. 
A complete performance and the undisputed MVP of the night. Take a bow, Ray @zhangrui_29 ! 👏💙💛
#calblue #mvp #soccer #swpl #bayareasoccer

WHAT A DEBUT! 💙
A 3-2 thriller for our first-ever SWPL match at semi-pro level, and we took all 3 points the hard way!
Down 0-1 early, we fought back to level it, took the lead 2-1, absorbed the pressure when they equalized 2-2, and sealed it with a dramatic last-minute winner! Pure heart, grit, belief and total teamwork until the final whistle.
This isn’t just a win; it’s our statement. For the club. For the community. For the culture.
Huge thank you to everyone who showed up and lit up Central Park Soccer Field with us. The journey in the SWPL has officially begun! 🚀🔥
#calblue #swpl #bayareasoccer #soccer

⚽ ⚽ New Season, New Chapter 💙💛

Bay Area powerhouse and Northern California Chinese Soccer League champions CalBlue FC are set to become the first all Chinese-American team to break into America‘s top semi-professional league, the SWPL! 💪🎉

Season Opener:
🆚 SF Glens SC (a storied club founded in 1961)
📅 Sunday, September 13, 7:00 PM
📍 Central Park Soccer Field, Fremont

Players — join us and showcase the spirit of Chinese-American soccer!
Fans — come light up the pitch with us. For the club. For the community. For the culture.

See you Sunday. 🔥

⚽ ⚽ 新赛季，新篇章💙💛

湾区老牌劲旅、北加州足联冠军CalBlue FC 即将成为首支杀入美国顶级半职业联赛SWPL的全华裔球队！！！💪🎉

赛季首战：
🆚 SF Glens SC（1961年劲旅）
📅 9月13日（周日）7:00 PM
📍 Central Park Soccer Field, Fremont

球星们，加盟我们，一同展示华人足球风采！
球友们，走进球场，为咱们的球队，为华人社区，尽情呐喊！

9/13 燃情之夜，我们一起点亮球场，开启新的篇章！！！
#swpl #bayareasoccer #soccer #calblue

CHAMPIONS AGAIN 🏆⚽️
2022: We held the trophy.
2023: Up 3-1 in the semis… then lost 3-5.
2024: Didn’t even make the top 4.
2025: We fought back. We rose. We WON.
Every setback fueled the fire.
This one means everything. 🔥 #Redemption #Champions
